title: Côte d’Ivoire National Day
author: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
summary:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Côte d’Ivoire National Day

Press Statement

August 7, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I offer my warmest congratulations to President Alassane Ouattara and the people of Côte d’Ivoire as they mark their 66th National Day.

The United States values its strategic relationship with Côte d’Ivoire. Together, we are expanding trade and investment, strengthening regional security, and creating new opportunities that benefit both the American and Ivoirian people.

As Côte d’Ivoire celebrates this important occasion, the United States looks forward to further strengthening our relationship in the years ahead.
